data.title: D · 蜜月露台的晚礼服凝睇
data.description: 伪装成蜜月度假的高级海景套房阳台，夜幕下一片宁静。D身着一袭优雅性感的黑色深V丝绸晚礼服，倚靠在雕花铁艺栏杆旁。夜风吹拂起她鬓边的发丝，平日里隐藏杀机的眼眸此刻倒映着海面碎浪与星辉，神情优雅从容，透出假戏真做般的深切眷恋。

data.promptProse: Standing beside the stone railing of a high-rise hotel balcony at midnight, D wears a sleek backless black satin evening gown with a high side slit and gold pendant. Turning back toward the viewer with serene, understated affection as night air stirs her dark-grey hair, she glows between starlight and warm balcony wall sconces.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the high-rise hotel balcony railing in a backless black satin evening gown and delicate pendant, she turns back with a calm, affectionate smile as night wind brushes her hair. Starlight and a warm balcony wall sconce frame her against the glittering city below.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sleek backless black satin evening gown with a deep side slit and a slender gold diamond pendant necklace.
